title: What "Be Perfect" Actually Means for the Man Who Keeps Failing
caption:
You mess up Tuesday morning and treat it like the verdict is already in.

Matthew 5:48 says be perfect, as your Father is perfect. In the Greek that word is teleios, the word for reaching what you were made for. Whole. Not flawless. Jesus says it right after telling you to love the people who are hard to love, the way your Father does.

That's why you can hunt down your own sin without mercy for it, and still give a brother who's still growing the same patience God gave you. He's not behind schedule. He's exactly where a wholehearted man starts.

Perfect was never about a spotless record. It was about not holding anything back.

#faith #scripture #manofgod #grace #christianmen #selfcontrol
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
